test_title: RRB NTPC CBT-I Official Paper (Held On: 1 Mar 2021 Shift 2)
subject: general
question: In a moderately asymmetrical distribution, the values of the mode and the mean are 31.5 and 34.2 respectively. Find the median of the distribution.
solution:
**Given:**

Mode = 31.5

Mean = 34.2

**Formula used:**

Mean - Mode = 3(Mean - Median)

**Calculation:**

34.2 - 31.5 = 3(34.2 - Median)

⇒ 2.7 = 3(34.2 - Median)

⇒ 2.7 = 102.6 - 3 × Median

⇒ 3 × Median = 102.6 - 2.7

⇒ 3 × Median = 99.9

⇒ Median = 99.9 / 3

⇒ Median = 33.3

**∴ The correct answer is option (3).**
